name: Hudson
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Hudson, NY
blurb: Upriver in Columbia County, where the river is narrower and the current has more of a say. The Hudson-Athens Lighthouse sits out in the channel, and South Bay is behind the rail causeway south of the launch.

tide.label: NOAA 8518974 Hudson
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518974, which is Hudson itself, so it is used unshifted.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA HUR0614_9 Hudson
current.note: Current from NOAA station HUR0614_9 (Hudson), about a mile and a half from the launch, at the 14 ft bin nearest the surface.
